title: Updates
blurb: Updates failing, stuck, or asking to restart.

remedies.title: Windows Update fails or shows an error
remedies.why: Damaged update files, too little disk space, or system files that need repair.

steps.text: Free up disk space (updates need 10–20 GB).
Restart, then try Windows Update again.
Reset Windows Update's components and downloads.
Repair system files.
Repair the Windows image.
Run Settings › System › Troubleshoot › Other troubleshooters › Windows Update.

remedies.escalate: Give IT the error code from Update history.

remedies.title: Update stuck at a percentage
remedies.why: Large updates can sit at one number for a long time; a slow connection or a damaged download can also stall it.

steps.text: Give it at least an hour on the charger, especially at "Working on updates" screens; don't turn it off then.
If it's stuck at Downloading for hours, restart and try again.
Reset Windows Update's downloads.
Check free space: macOS updates need 20 GB+.
Restart the Mac and run Software Update again; for repeated failures, update from macOS Recovery.

remedies.title: Check for updates
symptoms: is my computer up to date
remedies.why: Updates fix security holes and bugs; many problems disappear after updating.

steps.text: Settings › Windows Update › Check for updates. Also look at Advanced options › Optional updates for drivers.
System Settings › General › Software Update.
Update apps too: Microsoft Store › Library › Get updates, or App Store › Updates.

remedies.title: Something broke after an update
remedies.why: Occasionally an update clashes with a driver or app.

steps.text: Check Update history for what installed and when.
Uninstall the most recent update from Update history › Uninstall updates (security updates come back later, once fixed).
For a driver update, Device Manager › the device › Properties › Driver › Roll Back Driver.
System Restore to a point before the update (your files stay).
Pause updates for a week while it's sorted.

remedies.title: Updates keep asking me to restart
remedies.why: Installed updates only finish on a restart; the reminders continue until then.

steps.text: Restart at the end of the day; it takes a few minutes.
Set active hours so Windows never restarts while you work.
Choose "Try Tonight" in the macOS update reminder.
